raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "sign"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the contract"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be approved by"
      role subject "the contract"
      role object "the local council from Zalău"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be approved by"
      role subject "the contract"
      role time "August"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
